trick: Pilot round 4: total counts other cycles as monthly; rounding in its own sentence, no example (see CALIBRATION.md)
source_note: Not a trick and not a day. Calibration pilot for tasks/m5-weekly-plans (approved by Sebi 24 Oct: build the four-bug test project and rerun days 42-50 on it). Plain prompt on both sides; the sides differ only by model. Target: the season model (Haiku 4.5) passes all four bugs in 30-70% of runs and each bug is caught in some but not all runs. Per-bug results are in each row's grade_reason (BUGS B1=.. B2=.. B3=.. B4=..); tasks/m5-weekly-plans/bugs_table.py tallies them. Log of iterations: tasks/m5-weekly-plans/CALIBRATION.md. Rounds 3-4 run Haiku 4.5 on both sides (A/B, 5+5 = 10 season-model runs); pool them.
behaviour_count: per-bug pass counts (B1-B4) per side, from the BUGS fields of grade_reason
